title: fix(scripts): teardown-shape self-test refuses an unreachable pinned control as PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3)
body:
Fixes #18217

Clause-②: no — a gate's exit register is not a published contract face, and nothing under any package's `files[]` moves. Re-judged from the actual diff, measured below.

## What moved, and what deliberately did not

`node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exited **1** — the code reserved for a tree that is genuinely wrong — when a shallow clone could not reach the commit its positive control is pinned to. The true condition is PREREQUISITE NOT MET, which this tree already answers with exit **3**.

One file, three lines of behaviour:

1. The unreachable-control refusal returns `EXIT_PREREQUISITE_NOT_MET` instead of `1`.
2. The entry point's verdict handshake flattened **every** early return to 1, so a deliberately chosen code could not have survived it. It now preserves the prerequisite code alone; every other early return — including a bare `return`, which arrives as `undefined` and whose `process.exit(undefined)` is the exit-0 hole that handshake exists to close — is still 1.
3. A one-line note beside the pin says why this code differs from the failure code.

⛔ The refusal itself is unchanged: it fires where it fired, and its text — which already names `git fetch --unshallow origin main` — is byte-identical. Only the code moved. A self-test that RAN and genuinely failed still exits 1.

### Import or respell: measured on this tree, then followed

Both spellings of the constant exist under `scripts/`. **Imported** by check-dts-closure, check-i18n-bundles, check-i18n-coverage, check-i18n-walk-parity, check-sourcemap-no-sources-content, check-vendor-export-contract, ci/select-shard-timings-run, pm/check-dispatch-gates, pm/check-governed-merges and pm/dispatch-gates — the gate the card names as owning this code. **Re-declared locally** by check-test-completeness, check-release-section-coverage, pm/changeset-deadline-census, pm/check-half-states, pm/check-prior-rulings and pm/check-settings-deny-roster — each one a script that does not otherwise depend on that frame.

This gate already imports `scripts/import-prerequisite.mjs` (`requireDefaultExport`), so importing the constant from it adds no dependency edge and leaves the number declared once, in the module that argues it. Taken: **import**.

## Acceptance, both directions, on a REAL shallow clone

Not faked by editing the pin to a nonexistent sha. A throwaway `git clone --depth 1 file://…` of this branch's base: `git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` reads `true`, `git cat-file -e 621a487607881c66b2899b7e3477115229a156b4` exits 1 (the object is genuinely absent), and `node_modules` is symlinked in so the import-prerequisite guard is not the thing being measured.

| leg (same clone, same rev) | script under test | exit |
|---|---|---|
| unreachable pinned control | `origin/main` @ 25c9a8317 | **1** |
| unreachable pinned control | this branch | **3** |

`diff` over both runs' stdout **and** stderr is empty: the refusal text, remedy line included, is byte-identical.

| leg | reading |
|---|---|
| reachable control, this branch | exit 0, 48 cases pass |
| reachable control, `origin/main` @ 25c9a8317 | exit 0, 47 cases pass |
| injected genuine failure (`preFixResult.findings.length === 1` flipped to `=== 2`) | exit **1**, `1 of 48 case(s) failed` — not 3 |
| production leg (no `--self-test`), both trees | exit 0, verdict line byte-identical |

The pass line is byte-identical except its case COUNT, which went **up**, 47 to 48: the added case is this behaviour's pin. That battery's floor moves 1 to 2 with it, so deleting the case reds instead of silently shrinking the battery. Nothing goes down.

### The added case

The self-test spawns itself under a `git` that resolves nothing (a stub first on `PATH`, exiting 128). The branch taken is the same `show.status !== 0` the real shallow clone takes; what is pinned is the exit code together with the remedy text. Out of process deliberately — the code is only observable at the dispatch, and an in-process call would read a number the entry point could still flatten.

## Ablation ledger

Every leg through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor must hit, before/after counts, blob hashes, proven restore, EXIT/INT/TERM trap). Each restore printed `blob == HEAD (e4d9e35d06b1)` and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

| mutation | prediction | observed |
|---|---|---|
| `return EXIT_PREREQUISITE_NOT_MET;` to `return 1;` | the new pin reds | `1 of 48 case(s) failed`, exit 1 — the case reports the child status as 1 |
| dispatch `selfTestCode === EXIT_PREREQUISITE_NOT_MET ? … : 1` to `process.exit(1);` | the new pin reds | `1 of 48 case(s) failed`, exit 1 |
| `preFixResult.findings.length === 1` to `=== 2` (a self-test that RAN and failed) | exit 1, never 3 | exit **1**, `1 of 48 case(s) failed` |
| `const SELF = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);` to `return;` (the hole-2 handshake probe) | handshake holds: paragraph printed, exit 1, never 0 | exit **1**, paragraph printed |

## Gates

Derived at 19cae6e2b with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: **30 commands**, every one run, each exit code recorded, then reconciled:

```
✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 30 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 30 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED
  (a DERIVED zero — all 30 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3).
```

All 30 recorded `exit 0`. `check:pm-dispatch-gates` was detached and waited on by recorded PID with `tail --pid`, 818.5s on this box; its `exit 0` is read from two facts rather than claimed — the `&&` chain advanced past the first leg (so that leg exited 0), and the second leg was then re-run standalone with its status captured before any pipe (`exit=0`, 812.2s, 1746 cases pass).

## Changeset

`skip-changeset`, measured rather than assumed: the diff's only path is judged against every non-private manifest's `files[]` (70 manifests; the repo root is `private`). `scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs` lies under no package directory, so nothing published moves. Firing control on the same probe: `packages/lint/CHANGELOG.md` reads PUBLISHED via `@objectstack/lint` `files[] "CHANGELOG.md"`.

## Acceptance notes

- `node scripts/measure-self-test-floor.mjs --probe --only scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs` refuses on this tree (its handshake recogniser and the landed spellings disagree about three unrelated files) — so the handshake column is NOT MEASURED by that instrument here. Control: the refusal is byte-identical on `origin/main` @ 25c9a8317, so it pre-exists this change. The handshake is instead proven directly by the fourth ablation leg above. Reported to the dispatching seat as a candidate card; not filed from here.
- `lint.yml`'s step comment for this gate says "one `git show` and two spawns"; the added case makes it three. Not edited: this card's declared file surface is `scripts/`. Noted, not filed.
